% ss_prose_drift.tex — identical to ss_prose_good.tex except example 1's
% prose says c = 12 while the JSON expr still computes with 10: the drifted
% given must surface as "missing from JSON: [12.0]" on that example's line
% (report semantics — exit stays 0; the assertion is on the flag line).
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor}
\newmdenv{formulabox}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\begin{document}

\section*{Skills Summary}

\begin{formulabox}
$\sin A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$
\end{formulabox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} $A = 40^\circ$, $c = 12$. Find $a$.\\
$a = 10\sin 40^\circ = 10(0.642788) \approx \ans{6.43}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} A ramp runs $45$ and rises $30$. Find the angle.\\
$A = \tan^{-1}(30/45) \approx \ans{33.69^\circ}$
\end{examplebox}

\end{document}
